displacement.method: at w=0.3 the leg-added rows displace the same number off-window rows; count those that were qrels-relevant
displacement.note: nfcorpus off-window held 160 relevant rows; 3 of them were displaced by leg-additions

mechanism_audit.note: their 1/(60+p) mass cannot outvote the text legs; the leg's additions enter by graph-adjacency mass, not by relevance

added_rows_all_in_union_of_some_querys_r.note: 62 leg-added rows across 1000-query full runs all appear in the union of some query's relevant set ('wrong query's answer', not junk); on scidocs 16/16. nfcorpus union covers 86.1% of docs, so this is not a redeeming precision signal.
